answer: Weight is minted only from a sonnet that one karst signs through judged epochs; the ledge reads matching entropy, power or route as one principal and burns k^2 ledge for that principal’s kth head. A lone starter pays 1 ledge with 1 karst and 1 sonnet; n clones pay n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 ledge, and any shared karst folds the whole set into one head.
